statement.p: Calculate the flux integral \int_S(3\vec i+3\vec j+3\vec k)\cdot d\vec A where S is a disk of radius 5 in the plane x+y+z=3, oriented upward.

static.solution: 3\vec i+3\vec j +3\vec k is perpendicular to S and in the same direction as the orientation, and since ||3\vec i +3\vec j+3\vec k||=\sqrt{3^2+3^2+3^2}=\sqrt{27} on S, we have \int_S(3\vec i+3\vec j +3\vec k)\cdot d\vec A =\sqrt{27}\cdot\hbox{Area of circle }=\sqrt{27}\cdot\pi 5^2 =25\pi\sqrt{27}.
